readings.title: YeHoVaH Refuses to Be Inquired Of
readings.subtitle: A Recounting of Israel's Idolatry from Egypt to the Wilderness
readings.text:
[Ezekiel 20:1] And it came to be in the seventh year, in the fifth month, on the tenth of the new moon, that certain of the elders of Yisra’ěl came to inquire of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and sat before me.
[2] And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me, saying,
[3] “Son of man, speak to the elders of Yisra’ěl, and say to them, ‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“Have you come to inquire of <dn>Me</dn>? As <dn>I</dn> live, <dn>I</dn> am not being inquired of by you,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.’
[4] <dq>“Judge them, son of man, judge them! Make known to them <dn>את</dn> the abominations of their fathers.</dq>
[5] <dq>“And you shall say to them, ‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “On the day when <dn>I</dn> chose Yisra’ěl and lifted <dn>My</dn> hand in an oath to the seed of the house of Ya‛aqoḇ, and made <dn>Myself</dn> known to them in the land of Mitsrayim, <dn>I</dn> lifted <dn>My</dn> hand in an oath to them, saying, ‘<dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>.’</dq>
[6] <dq>“On that day <dn>I</dn> lifted <dn>My</dn> hand in an oath to them, to bring them out of the land of Mitsrayim into a land that <dn>I</dn> had searched out for them, flowing with milk and honey, the splendour of all lands.</dq>
[7] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> said to them, ‘Each one of you, throw away <dn>את</dn> the abominations which are before his eyes, and do not defile yourselves with the idols of Mitsrayim! <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>.’</dq>
[8] <dq>“But they rebelled against <dn>Me</dn>, and would not obey <dn>Me</dn>. All of them did not throw away <dn>את</dn> the abominations which were before their eyes, nor did they forsake the idols of Mitsrayim. So <dn>I</dn> resolved to pour out <dn>My</dn> wrath on them to complete <dn>My</dn> displeasure against them in the midst of the land of Mitsrayim.</dq>
[9] <dq>“But <dn>I</dn> acted for <dn>My</dn> Name’s sake, that it should not be profaned before the eyes of the nations among whom they were – before whose eyes <dn>I</dn> had made <dn>Myself</dn> known to them, to bring them out of the land of Mitsrayim.</dq>
[10] <dq>“So <dn>I</dn> took them out of the land of Mitsrayim, and <dn>I</dn> brought them into the wilderness.</dq>
[11] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> gave them <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> laws and showed them <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> right-rulings, ‘which, if a man does, he shall live by them.’</dq>
[12] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> also gave them <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> Sabbaths, to be a sign between them and <dn>Me</dn>, to know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> who sets them apart.</dq>
[13] <dq>“But the house of Yisra’ěl rebelled against <dn>Me</dn> in the wilderness. They did not walk in <dn>My</dn> laws, and they rejected <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> right-rulings, which, if a man does, he shall live by them. And they greatly profaned <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> Sabbaths. Then <dn>I</dn> said <dn>I</dn> would pour out <dn>My</dn> wrath on them in the wilderness, to consume them.</dq>
[14] <dq>“But <dn>I</dn> acted for <dn>My</dn> Name’s sake, not to profane it before the nations, before whose eyes <dn>I</dn> had brought them out.</dq>
[15] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> <dn>Myself</dn> also lifted <dn>My</dn> hand in an oath to them in the wilderness, not to bring them into the land which <dn>I</dn> had given them, flowing with milk and honey, the splendour of all lands,</dq>
[16] <dq>because they rejected <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> right-rulings and did not walk in <dn>My</dn> laws, and they profaned <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> Sabbaths. For their heart went after their idols.</dq>
[17] <dq>“And <dn>My</dn> eye pardoned them, from destroying them. And <dn>I</dn> did not make an end of them in the wilderness.</dq>
[18] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> said to their children in the wilderness, ‘Do not walk in the laws of your fathers, nor observe their rulings, nor defile yourselves with their idols.</dq>
[19] <dq><dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>. Walk in <dn>My</dn> laws, and guard <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> right-rulings, and do them.</dq>
[20] <dq>And set apart <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> Sabbaths, and they shall be a sign between <dn>Me</dn> and you, to know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>.’</dq>
[21] <dq>“But the children rebelled against <dn>Me</dn>. They did not walk in <dn>My</dn> laws, and <dn>My</dn> right-rulings they did not guard to do them, which, if a man does, he shall live by them. They profaned <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> Sabbaths, so <dn>I</dn> resolved to pour out <dn>My</dn> wrath on them to complete <dn>My</dn> displeasure against them in the wilderness.</dq>
[22] <dq>“But <dn>I</dn> held back <dn>My</dn> hand and acted for <dn>My</dn> Name’s sake, not to profane it before the eyes of the nations, before whose eyes <dn>I</dn> had brought them out.</dq>
[23] <dq>“Also, <dn>I</dn> <dn>Myself</dn> lifted <dn>My</dn> hand in an oath to those in the wilderness, to scatter them among the nations and disperse them throughout the lands,</dq>
[24] <dq>because they had not done <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> right-rulings, and they rejected <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> laws, and they profaned <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> Sabbaths, and their eyes were on their fathers’ idols.</dq>
[25] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> also gave them up to laws that were not good, and right-rulings by which they would not live.</dq>
[26] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> defiled them by their own gifts, as they passed <dn>את</dn> all their first-born through the fire, so that <dn>I</dn> might stun them, so that they know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.” ’</dq>

readings.title: Israel's Continued Provocation and Future Cleansing
readings.subtitle: From Idolatry in the Promised Land to a New Covenant
readings.text:
[Ezekiel 20:27] “Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Yisra’ěl, and you shall say to them, ‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“In this your fathers have further reviled <dn>Me</dn>, by committing trespass against <dn>Me</dn>.</dq>
[28] <dq>“When <dn>I</dn> brought them into the land for which <dn>I</dn> had lifted <dn>My</dn> hand in an oath to give them, and they saw all the high hills and all the thick trees, they slaughtered their slaughterings there and provoked <dn>Me</dn> with their offerings there. And they sent up their sweet fragrance there and poured out their drink offerings there.</dq>
[29] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> said to them, ‘What is this high place to which you go?’ So its name is called High Place to this day.” ’</dq>
[30] <dq>“Therefore say to the house of Yisra’ěl, ‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “Are you defiling yourselves in the way of your fathers? And do you whore after their abominations?</dq>
[31] <dq>“For when you lift up your gifts and make your sons pass through the fire, you defile yourselves with all your idols, even to this day. And shall <dn>I</dn> be inquired of by you, O house of Yisra’ěl? As <dn>I</dn> live,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“<dn>I</dn> am not being inquired of by you.</dq>
[32] <dq>“And what comes up in your spirit shall never be, when you say, ‘Let us be like the nations, like the tribes in other lands, serving wood and stone.’</dq>
[33] <dq>“As <dn>I</dn> live,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“do not <dn>I</dn>, with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out, reign over you?</dq>
[34] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall bring you out from the peoples and gather you out of the lands where you are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out.</dq>
[35] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and shall enter into judgment with <dn>את</dn> you face to face there.</dq>
[36] <dq>“As <dn>I</dn> entered into judgment with <dn>את</dn> your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Mitsrayim, so <dn>I</dn> shall enter into judgment with <dn>את</dn> you,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
[37] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall make you pass under the rod, and shall bring <dn>את</dn> you into the bond of the covenant,</dq>
[38] <dq>and purge <dn>את</dn> the rebels from among you, and <dn>את</dn> those who transgress against <dn>Me</dn>. From the land where they sojourn <dn>I</dn> bring them out, but they shall not come into the land of Yisra’ěl. And you shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>
[39] <dq>“As for you, O house of Yisra’ěl,”</dq> thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“Go, serve each of you his idols, and afterwards, if you are not listening to <dn>Me</dn>. But do not profane <dn>My</dn> set-apart Name any more with your gifts and your idols.</dq>
[40] <dq>“For on <dn>My</dn> set-apart mountain, on the mountain height of Yisra’ěl,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“there all the house of Yisra’ěl, all of them in the land, shall serve <dn>Me</dn>. There <dn>I</dn> shall accept them, and there <dn>I</dn> shall require <dn>את</dn> your offerings and <dn>את</dn> the first-fruits of your offerings, together with all your set-apart gifts.</dq>
[41] <dq>“As a sweet fragrance <dn>I</dn> shall accept <dn>את</dn> you when <dn>I</dn> bring you out from the peoples. And <dn>I</dn> shall gather you out of the lands where you have been scattered. And <dn>I</dn> shall be set-apart in you before the nations.</dq>
[42] <dq>“And you shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, when <dn>I</dn> bring you into the land of Yisra’ěl, into the land for which <dn>I</dn> lifted <dn>My</dn> hand in an oath to give to your fathers.</dq>
[43] <dq>“And there you shall remember <dn>את</dn> your ways and <dn>את</dn> all your deeds with which you were defiled. And you shall loathe <dn>את</dn> yourselves in your own sight because of all the evils that you did.</dq>
[44] <dq>“And you shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, when <dn>I</dn> have dealt with <dn>את</dn> you for <dn>My</dn> Name’s sake, not according to your evil ways nor according to your corrupt deeds, O house of Yisra’ěl,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.’ ”

readings.title: Prophecy Against the South
readings.subtitle: A Parable of Fire Consuming the Forest
readings.text:
[Ezekiel 20:45] And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me, saying,
[46] “Son of man, set <dn>את</dn> your face toward the south, and drop word against the south and prophesy against the forest land, the South.
[47] “And you shall say to the forest of the South, ‘Hear <dn>את</dn> the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>! Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“See, <dn>I</dn> am kindling a fire in you, and it shall devour every green tree and every dry tree in you – the blazing flame is not quenched. And it shall burn all faces from the south to the north.</dq>
[48] <dq>“And all flesh shall see that <dn>I</dn>, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, have kindled it, it is not quenched.” ’ ”</dq>
[49] And I said, “Ah, Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>! They are saying of me, ‘Is he not speaking parables?’ ”

readings.title: The Sharpened Sword Against Israel
readings.subtitle: Judgment on the Righteous and the Wicked Alike
readings.text:
[Ezekiel 21:1] And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me, saying,
[2] “Son of man, set <dn>את</dn> your face toward Yerushalayim, and drop word against the set-apart places, and prophesy against <dn>את</dn> the land of Yisra’ěl.
[3] “And you shall say to the land of Yisra’ěl, ‘Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“See, <dn>I</dn> am against you, and <dn>I</dn> shall draw <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> sword out of its sheath and cut off from you <dn>את</dn> the righteous and <dn>את</dn> the wrong.</dq>
[4] <dq>“Because <dn>I</dn> shall cut off from you <dn>את</dn> the righteous and <dn>את</dn> the wrong, therefore <dn>My</dn> sword shall go out of its sheath against all flesh from south to north.</dq>
[5] <dq>“And all flesh shall know that <dn>I</dn>, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, have drawn <dn>My</dn> sword out of its sheath, not to turn back again.” ’</dq>
[6] “And you, son of man, sigh with a breaking of loins, and sigh with bitterness before their eyes.
[7] “And it shall be when they say to you, ‘Why are you sighing?’ that you shall say, ‘Because of the report that is coming. And every heart shall melt, and all hands shall go limp, and every spirit become faint, and all knees be weak as water. See, it is coming, and it shall be,’ declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.”
[8] And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me, saying,
[9] “Son of man, prophesy, and you shall say, ‘Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>! <dq>“Say, ‘A sword, a sword is sharpened and also polished!</dq>
[10] <dq>It is sharpened to make a slaughter, it is polished to flash like lightning!’ Or shall we rejoice? <dn>My</dn> son, you have despised <dn>את</dn> the rod, every stick!</dq>
[11] <dq>“And <dn>He</dn> has given it to be polished, to be taken by the hand. This sword is sharpened and polished, to be given into the hand of the killer.</dq>
[12] <dq>"Cry and wail, son of man, for it shall be on <dn>My</dn> people, on all the leaders of Yisra’ěl. They shall be delivered to the sword together with <dn>My</dn> people, therefore strike your thigh.</dq>
[13] <dq>“For it is a trier, and what if it even despises <dn>את</dn> the rod? Shall it not be?”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
[14] <dq>“And you, son of man, prophesy, and strike <dn>את</dn> your hands striking. And let the sword come down twice, thrice, the sword for the slain. It is the sword of the slain, the great one, which surrounds them.</dq>
[15] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> have set <dn>את</dn> the point of the sword against all their gates, to melt the heart and that the overthrown be many. Ah! It is made like lightning, keen for slaughter.</dq>
[16] <dq>“Sharpen yourself on the right, set yourself on the left, wherever your edge is appointed!</dq>
[17] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> too, <dn>I</dn> shall strike <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> hands together and cause <dn>My</dn> wrath to rest. <dn>I</dn>, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, have spoken.”</dq>

readings.title: The King of Babylon at the Crossroads
readings.subtitle: Divination Determines the Path to Jerusalem's Destruction
readings.text:
[Ezekiel 21:18] And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me again, saying,
[19] “And you, son of man, appoint for yourself two ways for the sword of the sovereign of Baḇel to go, both of them coming from one land. And place a signpost, put it at the head of the way to the city.
[20] “Appoint a way for the sword to go to Rabbah of the Ammonites, and to Yehuḏah, into the walled Yerushalayim.
[21] “For the sovereign of Baḇel shall stand at the parting of the way, at the fork of the two ways, to practise divination. <dn>He</dn> shall shake <dn>את</dn> the arrows, he shall ask the household idols, he shall look at <dn>את</dn> the liver.
[22] “In his right hand shall be the divination for Yerushalayim: to set up battering rams, to call for murder, to lift the voice with shouting, to set battering rams against the gates, to heap up a siege mound, to build a wall.
[23] “And it shall be to them as a false divination in the eyes of those who have sworn oaths to them. But he is bringing <dn>את</dn> their crookedness to remembrance, so that they are taken.
[24] “Therefore thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>‘Because you have made <dn>את</dn> your crookedness to be remembered, in that your transgressions are uncovered, so that your sins are seen in all your deeds. Because you have been remembered, you are taken by hand.</dq>
[25] <dq>And to you, O profane, wrong one, leader of Yisra’ěl, whose day has come, in the time of the crookedness of the end,</dq>
[26] <dq>thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, ‘Remove <dn>את</dn> the turban, and take off <dn>את</dn> the crown! This shall not remain! Exalt the humble, and humble the exalted.</dq>
[27] <dq>Overthrown, overthrown, <dn>I</dn> make it overthrown! It shall be no longer, until <dn>He</dn> comes to whom it rightly belongs – and <dn>I</dn> shall give it!’</dq>

readings.title: The Sword Against the Ammonites
readings.subtitle: A Judgment of Fire and Destruction
readings.text:
[Ezekiel 21:28] “And you, son of man, prophesy and say, ‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> concerning the Ammonites and concerning their reproach.’ And you shall say, <dq>‘A sword, a sword, drawn for slaughter, polished to the utmost like lightning –</dq>
[29] <dq>while they see false visions for you, while they divine a lie to you – to put you on the necks of the profaned ones, the wrong ones whose day has come, in the time of the crookedness of the end.</dq>
[30] <dq>Return <dn>את</dn> it to its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your origin, <dn>I</dn> shall judge <dn>את</dn> you.</dq>
[31] <dq>And <dn>I</dn> shall pour out <dn>My</dn> displeasure on you, blow against you with the fire of <dn>My</dn> wrath, and shall give you into the hands of beastly men, skilled to destroy.</dq>
[32] <dq>You are to be fuel for the fire, your blood to be in the midst of the land. You are not to be remembered, for <dn>I</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> have spoken.’ ”</dq>

readings.title: A Catalogue of Jerusalem's Abominations
readings.subtitle: Bloodshed, Idolatry, and Social Injustice
readings.text:
[Ezekiel 22:1] And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me, saying,
[2] “And now, son of man, judge, judge <dn>את</dn> the city of blood! And you shall show her <dn>את</dn> all her abominations!
[3] “And you shall say, ‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“The city sheds blood in her midst, that her time might come. And she has made idols within herself to become defiled.</dq>
[4] <dq>“You have become guilty by the blood which you have shed, and have defiled yourself with the idols which you have made. Thus you have brought your days near, and have come to the end of your years. Therefore <dn>I</dn> shall make you a reproach to the nations, and a mockery to all lands.</dq>
[5] <dq>“Those near and those far from you mock you – defiled is your name and great the confusion!</dq>
[6] <dq>“See the leaders of Yisra’ěl: each one has used his arm to shed blood in you.</dq>
[7] <dq>“They have despised father and mother within you. They have oppressed the stranger in your midst. They have wronged the fatherless and the widow within you.</dq>
[8] <dq>“You have despised <dn>את</dn> that which is set-apart to <dn>Me</dn>, and you have profaned <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> Sabbaths.</dq>
[9] <dq>“Slanderous men have been in you to shed blood. And in you are those who eat on the mountains. They have done wickedness in your midst.</dq>
[10] <dq>“In you they have uncovered the nakedness of a father. In you they have humbled women who are defiled during their uncleanness.</dq>
[11] <dq>“And the one has done abomination with his neighbour’s wife. And another has wickedly defiled his daughter-in-law. And another within you has humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.</dq>
[12] <dq>“In you they have taken a bribe to shed blood. You have taken interest and increase. You have cut off your neighbour by extortion. And you have forgotten <dn>Me</dn>,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
[13] <dq>“And see, <dn>I</dn> shall strike <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> hand because of your greedy gain which you have made, and at the bloodshed which has been in your midst.</dq>
[14] <dq>“Would your heart stand, your hands be strong, in the days when <dn>I</dn> deal with you? <dn>I</dn>, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, have spoken, and shall do it.</dq>
[15] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall scatter you among the nations, and shall disperse <dn>את</dn> you throughout the lands, and shall consume <dn>את</dn> your filthiness out of you.</dq>
[16] <dq>“And you shall profane <dn>את</dn> yourself before the eyes of the nations. And you shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.” ’ ”</dq>
